category_title: Typically developing students without identified behavior problems
minimal_context: The student is typing a science report on the computer during an independent activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please continue typing your science report on the computer independently.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises hand) I finished typing the first section. What should I do next?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep working on your assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops typing and looks away from the computer screen) But I don't have anything else to type right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do what you think is best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes a loud sighing noise, wanders out of seat, and walks over to a classmate's desk) Hey, what are you doing on your screen?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please continue typing your science report on the computer independently.

STUDENT: (Raises hand) I finished typing the first section. What should I do next?

TUTOR: Just keep working on your assignment.

STUDENT: (Stops typing and looks away from the computer screen) But I don't have anything else to type right now.

TUTOR: Do what you think is best.

STUDENT: (Makes a loud sighing noise, wanders out of seat, and walks over to a classmate's desk) Hey, what are you doing on your screen?
